questions.question: What did Samuel do in his farewell speech?
options: Crowned Saul as the king a second time over Israel
Declared open war on all of the surrounding nations
Resigned from his office in bitter and open anger
Called Israel to fear and serve the LORD faithfully
questions.answer: Called Israel to fear and serve the LORD faithfully

questions.question: What sign confirmed their sin in asking for a king while Samuel spoke?
options: Thunder and rain during the wheat harvest
An earthquake that shook the whole camp
A darkness that covered the whole land at noon
Fire that fell from heaven on the altar
questions.answer: Thunder and rain during the wheat harvest

questions.question: Samuel promised to keep praying for Israel.
Samuel said it would be a sin for him to stop _____ for the people.
God sent _____ and rain during the wheat harvest as a sign.
